original.target_description: Rothman (2011), study 1: full primary paper not obtained. Publisher supplies abstract/references only; publisher PDF returned 403; OpenAlex supplied no OA full text and Lancaster record states full text unavailable.

replication.target_description: Study 1, L3 Portuguese learners with L1 English/L2 Spanish or L1 Spanish/L2 English: main effect of adjective position (preposed vs. postposed) on correct responses in the context-based collocation task; two-way ANOVA with participant random intercept.

reported_success.location: p. 1450 (PDF p. 12), Discussion and Conclusion, paragraph 1; Table 2
reported_success.quote: Overall, the results of the two ANOVAs point to a partial replication of the original analysis.

notes: Reported success is the authors’ overall partial-replication verdict, mapped to mixed; it is not an effect-specific significance inference. Original statistics quoted secondhand by the replication were not substituted for the unavailable original primary paper. Collocation analytic n is null because the reported participant total and ANOVA denominator degrees of freedom conflict; no sample size was reconstructed from df.
